blocks.title: A slow native handler blocks the platform's UI thread

content.text: By default your Kotlin or Swift handler runs on the platform's main thread, the one that draws native UI. Reading a big file or resizing an image there freezes it. Flutter's guide shows how to create a background Task Queue for the channel on Android and iOS, so the handler runs on another thread.
